sloka: तां हत्वा पुनरेवाहं कृत्यमात्ययिकं स्मरन् ।गत्वा चाहं महाध्वानं पश्यामि नगमण्डितम् ।। ५.५८.४५ ।।।।
transliteration: tāṁ hatvā punarevāhaṁ kṛtyamātyayikaṁ smaran ।gatvā cāhaṁ mahādhvānaṁ paśyāmi nagamaṇḍitam ।। 5.58.45 ।।।।

translations.english: "Having slained Simhika, I thought of the huge feat that I have done. I remembered the big mission before me and went to the southern shore of the ocean and saw Lanka full of trees.
